contract_review.item: Chinese HVC-001 round-button Famicom study drawings
contract_review.evidence: Chinese headings and technical descriptions throughout; page 1 states HVC-001 round-button revision; page 3 distinctly shows controller I START/SELECT and controller II MIC/VOLUME with round A/B buttons.
Independently read every PDF page rectangle: all 12 are 1190.55 x 841.89 points; all rendered pages carry consistent 1–12 numbering.

Pages 1 and 2 show width 150, depth 220 and height 60 mm; pages 1 and 12 repeat the published 150 × 220 × 60 mm envelope and distinguish cables/accessories. drawing_checks.json reports all three model envelope checks passed.

Page 3 ≈126; page 4 ≈121; page 7 ≈104 and ≈137; page 8 ≈96 and ≈57; page 10 ≈108 and ≈72. Every sheet carries the local-approximation boundary in the footer. Page 12 explicitly lists approximation scope.

contract_review.item: Model-derived dimensions and native TechDraw objects
contract_review.evidence: Reviewed drawing_checks.json and both native drawing audit reports. All 13 reported dimension references pass. Independently read Famicom_Drawings.FCStd Document.xml and counted 12 TechDraw::DrawPage and 13 TechDraw::DrawViewDimension objects.

Page 5 visibly presents A-A at Y=-23 and B-B at Y=35 with cut material fills and internal layer profiles; page 9 presents C-C at Y=-34. Section origin/method is explicitly disclosed. Reviewed drawing_checks.json statement of planar cross sections; no independent CAD intersection computation was performed.

Page 11 gives 13 assembly groups with display-material roles, noncontinuous component number bounds, and COMPONENTS.csv reference; page 12 gives source and maintenance paths. Independently counted CSV totals: 634 component entries and 1457 solids; all 13 assembly counts match the page 11 table. Page 7 component captions FAMICOM-0099, -0163 and -0194 plus page 9 FAMICOM-0183 match CSV identities.

contract_review.item: Readable figures, captions and safe layout
contract_review.evidence: Viewed all 12 supplied final page PNGs. No clipped headings or figures, overlapping captions, missing glyphs, stranded headings, split table rows, or illegible principal dimensions found. Fine CAD details retain sufficient separation for the drawing-sheet context; page 11 table is readable; page 12 is intentionally less dense as the closing reference sheet.

.local/famicom16_kami_content.txt records valid long-doc content and all 27 atomic values present, with 23 prose fields rephrased. .local/famicom16_kami_visual.txt records 12 page renders and TsangerJinKai02 for 3436 CJK ideographs.

scope_limits: This was an isolated contract/content/visual review of the final PDF and its supplied rendered pages, plus read-only inspection of local evidence. No CAD, PDF, script or browser state was edited.
The model dimensions, planar intersections, STEP round trips and interference results were not recomputed in this review; geometry acceptance uses the explicitly identified existing audit evidence.
Source indexing and consistency were checked locally; cited external webpages and original hardware were not independently remeasured or revalidated in this review.
Material names on page 11 are display roles, as labeled, and this review does not certify real material grades, tolerances, electrical behavior, thermal performance or manufacture readiness.
The pass applies to the recorded PDF SHA256 and the 12 supplied final PNGs actually viewed.
path_normalization: Installed skill references use a portable path prefix; review findings and artifact hashes are unchanged.
